wholePhysicalScope: Cotroceni Palace in April 2018. The royal residence, Neo-Romanian north wing and attached presidential wing surround two open mapped courts. The separately mapped church is outside this palace model.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the attached palace ranges, the round bay and both open courtyards. Near levels add recessed windows, rustication and belvedere details.
limitations: The model covers the connected palace exterior. The separately mapped Cotroceni church, grounds, park furniture and interiors are outside the palace model.

The cleared April 2018 photographs control the rusticated garden frontage, pale rounded bay, dark eaves and nearby window forms. Locations and dimensions of individual projections, roof pitches, rear elevations and hidden bay counts are estimates.
The original palace multipolygon retains both open courtyards. The 384 m independent terrain field and original Terrarium tiles remain unchanged. Site floor and threshold elevations are approximate.
